summary.text: Says Clark has advocated for affordability, housing, public safety, and core services.
summary.quote: I’ve fought for what matters most: affordability, housing, public safety, and the core services people rely on every day.

summary.text: Says Clark worked to move City Hall to the former EWEB building to save taxpayers over $30 million.
summary.quote: One example was my years-long push to move City Hall into the former EWEB building, saving Eugene taxpayers more than $30 million.

summary.text: Says Clark aims to represent Ward 5 and keep City Hall focused on solvable issues.
summary.quote: My job is to represent the families, workers, employers, and neighborhoods of Ward 5 and to keep City Hall focused on the issues we can actually solve.
